svg.aria-label: The domain cube and basis arrows map to a parallelogram and the matrix columns.

svg.title: A transparent unit cube in the three-dimensional domain
svg.desc: The labeled basis arrows match the colored matrix columns. In the last stage, three points with the same x and y but different z lie on a vertical line.

svg.title: The cube maps to a parallelogram in the two-dimensional codomain
svg.desc: The basis images are (1, 2), (2, 1), and (0, 0). Opposite cube vertices that differ only in z have the same image.
